title: discovery: probe_url double-brackets pre-bracketed IPv6
description: probe_url detects IPv6 by checking ip.contains(':'), but if the caller passes an already-bracketed address like '[fd7a::1]', the result is 'https://[[fd7a::1]]:port/...' — an invalid URL. The hyper client will reject the request, causing a silent None from probe_peer. The fix is to also guard against ip.starts_with('[').
